name: Roast duck
summary: Vịt quay is the roast duck of the eastern road, rubbed with mắc mật leaf. On that road it shares the table with olive sticky rice and smoked sausage.
howToEat: Have it at a meal on the eastern route or in town in the morning, and take one home as a gift.
where: The eastern road, and Cao Bang city.
seoTitle: Roast duck on the Cao Bang eastern road
